title: Greek professor says the Delphic women were literally possessed by the spirit of Zeus
summary: Luke Caverns tells of Greek professor says the Delphic women were literally possessed by the spirit of Zeus, about ancient Greece at Greece (the ancient oracle sites), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I've heard I've heard Greek uh professors say that you know these women who would become uh like as the vapors came up under the ground of Deli and the woman would become possessed with the spirit of Zeus.

plain: Luke Caverns, a researcher, says he has heard Greek history professors describe the women at Delphi, the ancient Greek shrine where priestesses gave prophecies. According to these professors, as he tells it, vapours rose from under the ground there and the women became possessed by the spirit of Zeus, the king of the Greek gods. If true, it would mean the ancient oracles were literally taken over by an outside intelligence.
